My first venture into doing this, or any, type of sheet metal bending. After a lot of research and watching several Youtoob reviews, I ordered this Vevor brake. Took my time building a sturdy bench just for the brake. Boy, this thing is heavy! At any rate, I just finished my first project (tube amp chassis) and was totally successful. I uses.060 aluminum, and the brake handled it easily. There's limitations with this brake, but I just engineered my way around them. Actually, my limitations are quite probably due to my having zero previous experience with tools like this, and I'm facing an expected learning curve on the uphill road to success. On delivery, I could see that the brake was securely packed and bolted in a wooden crate, but TBH the crate pretty much fell apart before it got here, and was taped together by the carrier. Zero damage to the tool, though. No harm, no foul. Happy I bought it, would definitely make this same choice again.
Used it in my metal fabrication shop for bending aluminum and mild steel. The clamping system holds metal tightly, no slipping during bending. Worth every euro for professional results.
The powder-coated finish resists rust and corrosion. Metal parts are thick and sturdy – built to last for years of heavy use.

Overall for a brake at this price point it works well enough. Material thickness adjustment is a struggle, but can be done, and although it will bend 16 gauge, I believe 18 gauge should be the max thickness of material, instruction manual is adequate, but needs improvement
